name: Pioneer Valley Cubing B 2023
information:
This is a series competition with [Pioneer Valley Cubing A 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PioneerValleyCubingA2023). You may only register for and compete in one of the two competitions. If you have already registered (with payment) for Pioneer Valley Cubing A 2023, your registration for this competition will be rejected.

**Competitors may bring only 2 guests to the competition due to covid safety. Please select 0 to 2 guests when registering for this competition.**
